note: Faroe Islands: the executive order on aliens' access to the Faroe Islands (bekendtgørelse nr. 636 af 7. juni 2010, amended 2014 and 2023) exempts from the Faroese work permit, for three months from entry (taken as 90 days), artists, musicians and performers and their staff who have agreed an engagement with an organiser in the Faroes beforehand (§ 34, stk. 2, nr. 2); beyond that, a work permit under § 35. The Faroese authorities (Útlendingastovan) took over permits on 1 September 2024; whether the order still stands unchanged under them wasn't confirmed, since utlendingastovan.fo refuses this client. Nordic citizens' free movement (the Aliens Act's § 14) wasn't read, so it isn't modelled; Danish citizens are home. Read in Lovtidende as retsinformation.dk publishes it.

sources.title: Lovtidende A 2010, Bekendtgørelse nr. 636 af 7. juni 2010 om udlændinges adgang til Færøerne
sources.said: Stk. 2. Følgende udlændinge er for et tidsrum af tre måneder fra indrejsen på Færøerne fritaget for arbejdstilladelse på Færøerne: ... Kunstnere, herunder musikere, artister og lignende samt tilknyttet personale, såfremt de forud for arrangementet har indgået aftale med en arrangør på Færøerne.
